name: reachable_final_150mm_stage_outside_eight_candidate_search
description: The corrected approach reaches its measured 170 mm initial disk, then the normal 150 mm final-stage request returns ik_failed. An additional candidate and independently checked complete route reach the actual final disk under the configured Orbbec FOV.

robot.goal: selected joint goal from XYZ + directed flange Z; local Z spin free

environment.scene_checker: PyBullet convex URDF hulls versus table and one axis-aligned box
environment.execution: kinematic reference interpolation; no calibrated dynamics or physical IO

provenance.change_from_previous_case: Keep the difficult start pose and move the fixed object 100 mm toward the EEF along its initial gaze, changing the approach from 270-to-150 (unreachable finish) to 170-to-150 (independently checked reachable finish).

limitations: The 150 mm distance is axial; off-center accepted endpoints can have larger Euclidean object distance.
The current bounded planner still fails the recorded request; independent witness proof does not mean the unchanged planner completes the task.
Visibility uses nominal Orbbec 640x480 RGB FOV 82x68 and the assumed identity optical mount; calibrated live intrinsics and full-object visibility remain unverified.
No physical hardware execution or rounded encoder qualification.
